newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Maccanico satisfied with mobile phone cover.
newsitem.headline: Italy Maccanico satisfied with mobile phone cover.

text.p: Italy's Post and Telecommunications Minister Antonio Maccanico on Friday said he was satisfied with the national coverage of Italy's two mobile phone systems -- analogue and GSM.
"The results obtained in national coverage can be considered satisfactory," Maccanico said in a reply to a parliamentary question.
The national coverage of the analogue system operated solely by Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) has reached 70 percent of Italian territory and 95 percent of the population.

For GSM, TIM covers 62 percent of territory and 92 percent of population, while Italy's second mobile phone player Omnitel -- where Olivetti has a 35.5 percent stake -- has 54 percent coverage of territory and 78 percent of the population.
